items.headline: Gold Holds Gain Above $4,100 as Lower Oil Eases Inflation Woes
items.summary: Gold held gains as inflation concerns eased alongside oil prices on hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the war in the Middle East. Bullion traded near $4,140 an ounce, after rising 1.7% on Monday and 5% last week.
